entries.title: Joint anatomy and basic immunology

testable_competencies.recognize: Use basic joint and immune terminology when interpreting a rheumatologic presentation.

entries.zero_question_reason: Foundational context is assessed only within clinical presentation units.

entries.title: Immune mechanisms and immunogenetics of rheumatic disease

testable_competencies.recognize: Relate broad immune mechanisms to rheumatic disease patterns.

entries.title: Approach to joint pain and patterns of joint involvement

mcc_evidence.objective_title: Oligoarthralgia (pain in one to four joints)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: The source is a diagnostic approach to acute and chronic patterns of pain affecting one to four joints.

mcc_evidence.objective_title: Polyarthralgia (pain in more than four joints)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: The source explicitly organizes the differential for polyarticular joint pain.

testable_competencies.recognize: Differentiate inflammatory, degenerative, crystal, infectious, and non-articular patterns.
testable_competencies.investigate: Use number and pattern of joints to focus the initial differential.

mcc_evidence.objective_title: Oligoarthralgia (pain in one to four joints)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Synovial-fluid testing is an important component of the diagnostic work-up for oligoarticular joint pain, not the whole presentation objective.

testable_competencies.investigate: Select and interpret cell count, Gram stain/culture, and crystal examination in an acute swollen joint.

mcc_evidence.objective_title: Oligoarthralgia (pain in one to four joints)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Septic arthritis is a high-acuity cause within the oligoarthralgia differential and demands immediate action.

testable_competencies.recognize: Recognize septic arthritis as an emergency.
testable_competencies.investigate: Obtain urgent joint fluid and cultures.
testable_competencies.manage: Start initial management and obtain urgent specialty input without testing drug regimens.

mcc_evidence.objective_title: Oligoarthralgia (pain in one to four joints)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Osteoarthritis is a common oligoarticular pain cause and a component of that presentation objective.

testable_competencies.recognize: Recognize the typical mechanical presentation and radiographic features.
testable_competencies.manage: Select broad nonpharmacologic and initial symptom-management concepts.

entries.title: Seropositive rheumatic disease and autoantibody interpretation

testable_competencies.recognize: Interpret serology only in a compatible clinical context.

entries.zero_question_reason: The table supports disease-specific units rather than a standalone diagnosis.

mcc_evidence.objective_title: Polyarthralgia (pain in more than four joints)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Rheumatoid arthritis is a central chronic inflammatory cause of polyarthralgia.

testable_competencies.recognize: Recognize inflammatory symmetric polyarthritis and extra-articular features.
testable_competencies.investigate: Use appropriate initial inflammatory and serologic testing.
testable_competencies.manage: Recognize need for early rheumatology referral and broad DMARD principles.

entries.title: Systemic lupus erythematosus and Raynaud phenomenon

mcc_evidence.objective_title: Polyarthralgia (pain in more than four joints)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: SLE may present with polyarthralgia, but the source's essential multisystem diagnostic and complication scope is narrower and broader than the joint-pain objective.

testable_competencies.recognize: Recognize multisystem features that suggest SLE.
testable_competencies.investigate: Identify initial testing and organ-threatening features needing urgent referral.

entries.title: Antiphospholipid antibody syndrome

mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: APS is an important thrombotic cause, but prevention of venous thrombosis does not fully support its diagnostic and pregnancy-morbidity scope.

testable_competencies.recognize: Recognize arterial or venous thrombosis and pregnancy morbidity suggestive of APS.
testable_competencies.manage: Arrange urgent appropriate specialty and obstetric/hematology collaboration when indicated.

entries.cross_discipline_note: Thrombosis and pregnancy-loss implications cross hematology and obstetrics; ownership is not finalized here.

testable_competencies.recognize: Recognize systemic sclerosis and possible pulmonary, renal, or digital complications requiring referral.

mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Inflammatory myopathy is a clinically important cause of non-stroke weakness within the objective's presentation scope.

testable_competencies.recognize: Recognize proximal weakness and characteristic dermatomyositis findings.
testable_competencies.investigate: Initiate basic evaluation and identify respiratory or swallowing risk requiring urgent referral.

testable_competencies.recognize: Recognize sicca symptoms with systemic features and the need for appropriate assessment or referral.

entries.title: Mixed connective tissue disease

testable_competencies.recognize: Recognize overlapping systemic autoimmune features that merit rheumatology assessment.

entries.zero_question_reason: Specific diagnostic classification and treatment are specialist-level.

entries.title: Overlap syndrome

testable_competencies.recognize: Recognize that overlapping autoimmune features require specialist assessment.

entries.zero_question_reason: Specific overlap classification is specialist-level context.

entries.title: Small-vessel non-ANCA-associated vasculitis

testable_competencies.recognize: Recognize systemic vasculitic features and arrange appropriate referral.

entries.zero_question_reason: Specific subtype classification and treatment are specialist-level.

mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: A pulmonary-renal vasculitis can cause hematuria, but the hematuria objective only partially supports this urgent multisystem pattern.

testable_competencies.recognize: Recognize a pulmonary-renal or systemic vasculitic presentation.
testable_competencies.manage: Escalate urgently for organ-threatening disease without testing induction-regimen details.

entries.title: Medium-vessel vasculitis

testable_competencies.recognize: Recognize features of systemic medium-vessel vasculitis and refer.

entries.zero_question_reason: Subtype-specific diagnosis and treatment are specialist-level.

entries.title: Large-vessel vasculitis

mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Giant-cell arteritis is an urgent reversible cause of acute visual loss, although the objective covers a wider differential.

testable_competencies.recognize: Recognize giant-cell-arteritis features and imminent visual risk.
testable_competencies.manage: Act urgently and arrange prompt specialist assessment without fixing treatment doses.

entries.cross_discipline_note: Visual-risk presentation overlaps ophthalmology; ownership is not finalized here.

mcc_evidence.objective_title: Back pain and related symptoms (e.g., sciatica)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Ankylosing spondylitis is a key inflammatory-back-pain cause within this broader symptom objective.

testable_competencies.recognize: Differentiate inflammatory from mechanical back pain and recognize extra-articular manifestations.
testable_competencies.manage: Arrange appropriate investigation and rheumatology referral.

entries.title: Enteropathic arthritis

mcc_evidence.objective_title: Polyarthralgia (pain in more than four joints)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Enteropathic arthritis can produce polyarthralgia, but its essential inflammatory-bowel-disease linkage is not represented by the joint-pain objective.

testable_competencies.recognize: Recognize inflammatory arthritis associated with inflammatory bowel disease and coordinate referral.

entries.cross_discipline_note: The underlying bowel disease crosses gastroenterology; ownership is not finalized here.

mcc_evidence.objective_title: Polyarthralgia (pain in more than four joints)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Psoriatic arthritis is an inflammatory cause of polyarthralgia within the broader presentation objective.

testable_competencies.recognize: Recognize inflammatory joint disease associated with psoriasis and arrange referral.

mcc_evidence.objective_title: Oligoarthralgia (pain in one to four joints)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Reactive arthritis is a postinfectious cause in the oligoarthralgia differential.

testable_competencies.recognize: Recognize a postinfectious asymmetric arthritis with ocular or genitourinary features.

mcc_evidence.objective_title: Oligoarthralgia (pain in one to four joints)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Gout is a common acute oligoarticular crystal cause within the presentation objective.

testable_competencies.recognize: Recognize acute gout and distinguish it from septic arthritis.
testable_competencies.manage: Apply broad initial management and prevention concepts without fixed regimens.

mcc_evidence.objective_title: Oligoarthralgia (pain in one to four joints)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: CPPD is an acute oligoarticular crystal cause within the broader presentation objective.

testable_competencies.recognize: Recognize CPPD as a differential for acute monoarthritis and interpret its crystal pattern.

mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: PMR is a characteristic nonarticular proximal-pain presentation within the broader objective.

testable_competencies.recognize: Recognize proximal girdle pain and stiffness and screen for temporal-arteritis symptoms.
testable_competencies.manage: Arrange appropriate assessment and urgent escalation if visual-risk symptoms occur.

mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Fibromyalgia is a generalized pain disorder and the source covers diagnosis, exclusion of mimics, and initial management concepts.

testable_competencies.recognize: Recognize fibromyalgia after appropriate consideration of inflammatory and other mimics.
testable_competencies.manage: Explain multimodal, nonpharmacologic-forward initial management concepts.

testable_competencies.recognize: Recognize broad medication-class safety considerations when relevant to a clinical case.
